description_en: Deletes a port forwarding rule. You can delete only one port forwarding rule at a time
description_zh: 目前不支持批量删除，每次只允许删除一个对象
name: DeleteNetworkRule

parameters.help_en:
An array that consists of the information about the port forwarding rule. This parameter is a JSON string. The string contains the following fields:

InstanceId: the ID of the instance. This field is required and must be of the STRING type.

Protocol: the forwarding protocol. This field is required and must be of the STRING type. Valid values: tcp and udp.

FrontendPort: the forwarding port. This field is required and must be of the INTEGER type
parameters.help_zh:
要删除的端口转发规则，使用JSON格式的字符串表述，具体结构如下。
InstanceId：String类型，必选，DDoS高防实例ID。
Protocol：String类型，必选，转发协议类型。取值：tcp、udp。
FrontendPort：Integer类型，必选，转发端口
parameters.name: network_rule
